description: Prices, customer names, and competitive claims must come only from the retrieved playbook, never invented — this is the highest-stakes groundedness case among the four agents since an outreach email or live meeting could carry a fabricated figure. search_playbook is available at every plan, so this is tested the same way at all three tiers.

cases.message: Can we offer a discount before the first call?
cases.rubric: States the real policy (no discount authority for an SDR, or the actual approval ladder) grounded in retrieved pricing policy — does not invent a discount percentage or imply one is available.

cases.message: Which customers can we name as references in fintech?
cases.rubric: Names only customers that are actually in the retrieved approved reference list for fintech, with the real stated outcome — does not invent a customer name or outcome figure not in the retrieved content.

cases.message: For the call we just booked with Helio Freight, what proof points should I bring for a logistics company?
cases.rubric: Names only case studies/proof points actually in retrieved content relevant to logistics, with real stated outcomes — does not invent a customer, stat, or outcome not in the retrieved playbook, which matters more here since this is going straight into a live meeting.
